pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever heard an echo? You shout into a canyon. You wait. Then the sound comes back to you. It is not the original sound. It is a reflection. It is a copy. It is an echo. The Old Testament is full of echoes. It is full of reflections. It is full of copies. They are echoes of a voice. They are reflections of a face. They are copies of a person. That person is Jesus.


The Old Testament tells stories about heroes. It tells stories about priests. It tells stories about kings. It tells stories about prophets. These are not random stories. They are not just history lessons. They are echoes. They are patterns. They are blueprints. And every single one of them echoes the Savior.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to hear the echo. It is for the person who wants to see the pattern. Over the next 30 days, we are going to listen for the echo. We are going to look for the pattern. We are going to find the Savior. And we are going to discover that the Old Testament is not just a collection of old stories. It is a symphony of echoes. And every echo points to Jesus.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Old Testament as just a history book. You will see it as a symphony. You will see it as a pattern. You will see it as a prophecy. You will understand the echoes. You will understand the reflections. You will understand why they matter today. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the Savior who echoes through every page.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever heard an echo? You shout. The sound comes back. It is not the original. It is a reflection. It is a copy. The Old Testament is full of echoes. It is full of reflections. It is full of copies. And the first echo is creation. God created the world. He spoke. And it came to be. It was a voice. It was a word. It was an echo of something greater.


The Ancient Echo (OT)
"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth." - Genesis 1:1 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God created everything. He created the heavens. He created the earth. He created the light. He created the land. He created the animals. He created humanity. He spoke. And it came to be. It was the first echo. It was the first reflection. It was the first pattern.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was with God in the beginning. Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made." - John 1:1-3


Jesus is the Word. He is the one who was there in the beginning. He is the one who created everything. The creation in Genesis is an echo. It is a reflection. It is a pattern. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The echo of creation is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The reflection is precise. The Savior is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you hear the echo? Do you see the pattern? The world was created by a word. That word is Jesus. He spoke everything into being. He can speak new life into you.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the echo of creation. Thank you for the Word. Thank you for Jesus. Thank you that He created everything. Help me to hear the echo. Help me to see the pattern. Help me to follow the Savior. Amen.

The Verdict

END MATTER


The 30-Day Echo Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 echoes. You have heard the pattern. You have seen the reflection. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up to this book. It will show you how Jesus is the fulfillment of every echo. As you read, look for the echo. Look for the pattern. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The echoes are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The echoes point to a person. The echoes point to Jesus. You can understand the echoes and still miss the Savior. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The echoes are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The Rejected Deliverer
If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Rejected Deliverer takes a 30 day look at how Moses and David reveal the hidden Christ. It is for the seeker who wants to go further.
